name: pinned-tab-joins-solo-folder-first
description: A pinned tab dropped above the only member of a one-tab folder must become the first member, not land beside the last (its only) member. Real cgevent drag through the browser's input pipeline, chrome.send spied from the page.

actions.expression: (() => { const pane = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)'); if (!pane) { return 'no-pane'; } const title = (r) => (r.querySelector('.tl') || r).textContent.trim(); const at = (name) => { const el = [...pane.querySelectorAll('.tabrow, .frow')].find((r) => title(r) === name); return el ? Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top) : -1; }; return ['Loose', 'Solo Folder', 'Solo'].map(at).join(','); })()

(() => { window.__reset = () => { window.__ev = []; window.__cs = []; return 'reset'; }; window.__reset(); for (const t of ['dragstart','dragover','drop','dragend']) { document.addEventListener(t, () => { if (window.__ev[window.__ev.length-1] !== t) { window.__ev.push(t); } }, true); } const orig = chrome.send.bind(chrome); chrome.send = (name, args) => { if (name === 'sidebarTabGrouped') { window.__cs.push([name, args]); } return orig(name, args); }; return 'spying'; })()

(() => { const pane = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)'); const title = (r) => (r.querySelector('.tl') || r).textContent.trim(); const zone = pane.querySelector('.foldin[data-dropzone="pinned"]'); return [...zone.children].filter((el) => el.matches('.tabrow, .frow')).map((el) => el.matches('.frow') ? 'F[' + [...el.nextElementSibling.querySelectorAll('.tabrow')].map(title).join('+') + ']' : title(el)).join(' | '); })()

assertions.desc: gates the drag: the rows sit where the screen coordinates below assume
a real mouse drag reaches every drag event, drop included
THE MEASUREMENT: one message, carrying member slot 0 - no follow-up reorder
the tab dropped above the only member landed first, not beside it as the last
